# SalaryByCity

> US Salary & Wage Data by Occupation and City

Explore salary data for 800+ occupations across 400+ US metro areas. Compare wages, see percentile ranges, and find the highest-paying cities for your career.

## Core pages
- [Methodology and data sources](https://salarybycity.com/methodology/): how every figure is derived, with primary-source citations
- [Jobs directory](https://salarybycity.com/jobs/): browse every job we cover
- [About and editorial standards](https://salarybycity.com/about/): authorship and review policy

## Data
- Primary sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — OEWS, U.S. Census Bureau — American Community Survey, U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis — Regional Price Parities, U.S. Internal Revenue Service — Statistics of Income
- All figures are derived from these primary sources; see /methodology/ for derivation and vintage.
